verse.verse_2: and by the night when it covers,
verse.verse_3: your Lord has not forsaken you (Prophet Muhammad), nor does He hate you.
verse.verse_4: The Last shall be better for you than the First.
verse.verse_5: Your Lord will give you, and you will be satisfied.
verse.verse_6: Did He not find you an orphan and give you shelter?
verse.verse_7: Did He not find you a wanderer so He guided you?
verse.verse_8: Did He not find you poor and suffice you?
verse.verse_10: nor drive away the one who asks.
verse.verse_11: But tell of the favors of your Lord!
